newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Banque Mediterranee plans new Euro CD.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Banque Mediterranee plans new Euro CD.

text.p: Banque de la Mediterranee, Lebanon's biggest bank, plans a five-year $100 million EuroCD issue in the first half of 1997, Chairman Mustafa Razian said on Tuesday.
"We are preparing a five-year issue of $100 million and we are considering the most opportune time to issue it....We will do it prior to mid-year," Razian told Reuters in a telephone interview.
The issue will complete a $300 million EuroCD programme that Mediterranee launched in 1996.
It made a $100 million two-year EuroCD issue last September, followed by a three-year $100 million issue in October.

Mediterranee more than doubled its capital at the end of 1996 to $212 million from $102 million, Razian said. Banque Audi, the second-placed Lebanese bank in terms of shareholders' equity, has $63 million capital.
